summary_md: **Unsloth ([@UnslothAI](https://x.com/UnslothAI/status/2115453111208919472))** announces browser-use support for local LLMs: a locally run model can now drive a browser and complete tasks autonomously. Their demo has **Qwen3.8-27B** playing chess and painting in the browser with no human intervention. Links to the Unsloth repo and a *Browser Use with Local LLMs* guide.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - unslothai/unsloth: Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models. Supports GGUF, MLX, Qwen3.8, DeepSeek-V4.1, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, FLUX and more.
Browser Use with Local LLMs | Unsloth Documentation

relevance: Agentic computer-use with a ~27B local model is exactly the 'agent-friendly mid-tier' workload a Spark is suited for.

media.description: Demo video; preview frame shows a grid of browser sessions including a chess board, a pool game and a painting canvas.
